posts.name: The Washington Post
posts.text:
Stepping up and down the stairs could help control blood sugar after someone consumed a large amount of sugar, a study found. 

This workout, which lasted 60 seconds, smoothed people’s subsequent blood sugar responses, cutting spikes by about 40 percent.
posts.text_ko:
계단을 오르락내리락하는 것은 누군가가 많은 양의 설탕을 섭취한 후 혈당 조절에 도움이 될 수 있다는 연구 결과가 나왔습니다. 

60초간 지속된 이 운동은 사람들의 이후 혈당 반응을 원활하게 하여 급상승을 약 40% 줄였습니다.

posts.text: President Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin reached one major agreement at their three-way summit — an effort to further unravel the international system of cooperation that has existed since World War II.
